Privacy policy

Effective from: 5 November 2026. Česky

Operator

Jaroslav Patočka, contact: admin@insertcreator.com. You can use this contact for questions and to exercise your rights.

Photos and designs

  • Photos are processed on your device. They are not sent to our server or to anyone else.
  • The app only receives the photo you choose. It cannot see your gallery or camera and does not read the location from the photo.
  • The photo is not stored after processing. Only the resulting outline and design settings are kept.
  • Designs and your library stay in your browser's storage. Clearing the site data deletes them. We do not back them up.

Visitor measurement

On desktop and in the mobile version, but only with your consent, we use Google Analytics from Google Ireland Limited to see how many people use the app. The legal basis is your consent. Without it, Google Analytics does not start. Advertising features are switched off. Data may be transferred to the USA as part of Google's services.

You can withdraw consent at any time with the Cookie settings link in the app footer. Your choice is stored in your browser and we ask again after a year. The desktop and mobile versions store your choice separately.

Hosting

The site runs on Webglobe hosting. As with any website, the server may record technical data during a visit, such as IP address and request time, for operation and security.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object. You can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.gov.cz).

Optional background removal on a local PC

The “Remove background and shadows first” mode sends the selected photo to this app’s server. In the local version, that server runs on your PC; a phone can send its photo over your local network. A disposable process performs the calculation, without sending the image to Lift or another external service or writing it to application logs. This mode is identified before upload. Other selection and editing tools, and importing an already transparent PNG, can run in the browser without this service.
